segments.tha-ap19:2.1: “Kaṇikārapupphaṃ [kaṇikāraṃ pupphitaṃ (sī. syā.)] disvā, vaṇṭe chetvānahaṃ tadā;
segments.tha-ap19:3.3: Buddhena navame tattha, samaṇe aṭṭha bhojayiṃ.
segments.tha-ap19:7.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati [yaṃ vadanti sumedhoti, bhūripaññaṃ sumedhasaṃ; kappeto satasahasse, esa buddho bhavissati;(ka.)].
segments.tha-ap19:9.3: [idaṃ pādadvayaṃ theragāthāaṭṭhakathāyameva dissati] Samantapāsādikattā, aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapessati [idaṃ pādadvayaṃ theragāthāaṭṭhakathāyameva dissati].
segments.tha-ap19:10.3: Dhāremi antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhanaṃ [savāhiniṃ (?)].
segments.tha-ap19:12.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā upaseno vaṅgantaputto thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: So evaṃ pattaetadaggaṭṭhāno attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassavasena pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento padumuttaraṃ bhagavantantiādimāha.
Pabbhāramhi nisīdantanti purato bhāraṃ namitaṃ onamitanti pabbhāraṃ vivekakāmaṃ vanamajjhe sayaṃjātapabbatapabbhāre nisinnaṃ naruttamaṃ bhagavantaṃ ahaṃ upagacchiṃ samīpaṃ gatoti attho.
Kaṇikārapuppha disvāti tathā upagacchanto tasmiṃ padese supupphitaṃ kaṇikāraṃ disvā.
Vaṇṭe chetvānahaṃ tadāti tasmiṃ tathāgatassa diṭṭhakāle taṃ pupphaṃ vaṇṭe vaṇṭasmiṃ chetvāna chinditvāna.
Buddhassa abhiropayinti pabbhāre nisinnassa buddhassa muddhani akāsinti attho.
Piṇḍapātañca pādāsinti tasmiṃyeva nisinnassa bhagavato piṇḍapātaṃ pakārena adāsiṃ bhojesinti attho.
Buddhena navame tatthāti tasmiṃ vivekaṭṭhāne buddhena saha navame aṭṭha samaṇe samitapāpe khīṇāsavabhikkhū bhojesinti attho.
